title: Magnetic relaxation for the MHD equations via the stable manifold method
summary: We prove that given any sufficiently small and regular solution $B$ of the stationary Euler equations there exists an infinite dimensional family of solutions $(u,b)$ of the non-resistive magnetohydrodynamics equations (MHD) that relax to $(0, B)$. More precisely, $(u,b) \to (0, B)$ exponentially fast as $t \to +\infty$. This family may be viewed as lying in the stable manifold of the non-resistive MHD equations around the equilibrium state $(0, B)$.
